svg.font-family: Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: phu avger: finding auxiliary viral gene (AVG) candidates in viral contigs
translation table chosen for each contig
Translated proteins (at least 30 aa by default)
Predictions are cached and shared with phu screen and phu jack
E-value ≤ 1e-5; best hit per protein in each database
Pfam GA cutoffs · KOfam KO thresholds · PHROG bit score ≥ 60, coverage ≥ 0.4
→ feeds functional calls and reference matching (panel D)
Each database is searched once; the two tracks differ only in the thresholds applied to the hits
Pfam, KOfam and PHROG are scored and averaged independently; values are never mixed
Relaxed-track hits are looked up in the V / VL table, separately for each database
contig AVL (per database) = mean VL of the contig's scored genes
how exclusively a protein family occurs in viruses (10 = virus only)
V-score weighted by how often the family is found in viruses
average VL across a contig, per database: the viral context of a gene
passes in at least one database
Match strict hits to the CheckAMG positive lists
AMG: Pfam, KOfam · APG and AReG: Pfam, KOfam, PHROG
an essential or structural hit in any database, PHROG included, removes the class
All calls are computational candidates for prioritisation, not confirmed auxiliary genes.
Scores: Zhou et al. 2026 · reference tables: CheckAMG · terminology: Martin et al. 2025 · gene values shown are illustrative
